title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
goal: Solve Longest Increasing Subsequence: Patience sorting with binary search on a tails array to maintain O(n log n) time.
strategy: Patience sorting with binary search on a tails array to maintain O(n log n) time.
edgeCases: Strictly increasing subsequences cannot extend with an equal value; replacing a tail need not mean that tail list itself is the final witness.
